text: ふむ…　おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…　タイム　イズ　マネー…　…　ときは　かねなりか

structure.jp: おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…
structure.en: to think you don't even have time to watch the Teachy TV…

structure.jp: タイム　イズ　マネー…　…
ときは　かねなりか

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは at the end of a trailing-off sentence shows surprise at what was just said, like 'to think that…'. じかんも ないとは = 'to think you don't even have the time'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おしえテレビを　みる　じかん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you what kind of thing it is. おしえテレビを みる じかん = 'time to watch the Teachy TV'.

patterns.name: 〜なり
patterns.explanation: なり is an old, proverb-style way of saying だ, 'is'. ときは かねなり = 'time is money'.
